name: real_v2_b0_diagnostics
user_approval: 2026-11-08, explicit answers to the cross-domain draft (docs/research/2026-11-08/跨域阶段草案_v1.md): (1) re-split Real 70/30 by association group with a sealed final-test part; (2) the old rule 'test_fault not for supervised training' is superseded by this protocol line; (3) GBT/CPU route (B0, B1) first, T1 MSTCA later
purpose: Zero-risk diagnostics on the Real development pool before any Real-supervised learning curve (B1): (B0-1) is there a Real-internal session shortcut between independent normal flights and pre-fault segments; (B0-2) can Real labels be separated at all by the 130-dim window statistics (Real-only ceiling), and is the separation within the same flight session; (B0-3) label and exposure audit. No operating point, no event metric, no model is kept for deployment.
history_disclosure: All 465 Real cases were evaluated before (10-30 v1, 11-06 M0/ENS events, 11-06 GBT_D2/D3); aggregate results are known. Adapt/calibrate normals were used to fit GBT_D2/D3. The sealed part is therefore 'not used for development on this line', not blind.
No Real-supervised (fault-label) training has been done on causal_input_v1.

split.rule: unit association group; stratum (flight directory, family key: motor / sensor / normal_full / normal_segment); within stratum order by sha256('real_v2|'+group), first floor(0.3n+0.5) groups sealed, remaining dev with dev_fold 0..4 round-robin in the same order
split.counts: dev 320 cases (motor-stratum 158, sensor 112, normal_full 33, normal_segment 17), sealed 145 (66, 57, 15, 7); label_quarantine 5 dev / 4 sealed

population.windows: ledgers/real_included_windows.csv rows of those cases (all supervised_valid); label qualified_y; window tensors from windows/<case>.npz matched by original_cache_index (y must equal qualified_y)
population.sealed: never opened: no cases/ or windows/ npz of sealed cases is loaded; sealed rows are dropped from the ledger before any computation; the script asserts this

features_and_model.features: 130-dim window statistics (mean, std, min, max, mean |diff| over 26 channels), identical to stats() in artifacts/ens_internal_test_v1_20261105/run_test.py
features_and_model.recipe: HistGradientBoostingClassifier(max_iter=400, learning_rate=0.05, max_leaf_nodes=31, l2_regularization=1.0, random_state=0), sklearn defaults otherwise; no hyperparameter search
features_and_model.cv: out-of-fold predictions over dev_fold 0..4 from the split file; group-disjoint by construction

reproduction_gate: before any B0 metric: for every dev case with role_v1 in {adapt_normal, calibrate_normal}, the number of windows and the count of S probabilities >= 0.5 must equal the D0 row (windows, GBT_win_fp05) of artifacts/real_normal_adapt_v2_dev_20261106/real_dev_per_case.csv; any mismatch stops the run

B0_1_session_shortcut.task: positive = windows of dev normal_full cases with normal_origin normal_flight; negative = windows with phase pre_fault from dev fault cases
B0_1_session_shortcut.metric: OOF AUC with association-group cluster bootstrap CI (2000, rng 20261108); per flight directory AUC (descriptive)
B0_1_session_shortcut.sensitivity: negative restricted to pre_fault windows with window_end_row <= fault_onset_row - 250 (>= 5 s before reference onset)
B0_1_session_shortcut.descriptive: S probability distribution on both populations (median, share >= 0.3744, share >= 0.5)
B0_1_session_shortcut.interpretation: AUC point >= 0.80 strong session difference; 0.65-0.80 moderate; < 0.65 weak. Consequences are written into the B1 protocol after user review, not changed here.

B0_2_separability.arm_R: Real-only GBT on dev windows, label qualified_y, weights as in gbt_full_train (fault 1; normal total = number of normal windows, split 50/50 between normal_origin normal_flight and normal_part_of_fault_case)
B0_2_separability.arm_S: frozen source GBT on the same windows

metrics.a_all: AUC and AP, fault vs all normal windows
metrics.b_within_session: AUC, fault windows vs pre_fault windows of dev fault cases (main separability number)
metrics.c_vs_normal_flight: AUC, fault windows vs normal_flight windows; (c) - (b) reported as a session-inflation indicator
metrics.strata: (a)-(c) separately for motor and sensor fault windows (normal side unchanged)
metrics.fpr_at_recall: descriptive: thresholds on pooled OOF giving fault recall 0.5 and 0.8; normal FPR per normal population (normal_full flights, supplemental normal segments, pre_fault, post_fault_normal, transition with qualified_y 0); note supplemental segments carry normal_origin normal_flight in the ledger
metrics.ci: association-group cluster bootstrap (2000, rng 20261108) for every AUC

B0_2_separability.b1_recommendation_rule: GO if arm R (b) pooled AUC point >= 0.75; STOP (back to data) if arm R (b) pooled CI upper < 0.65; otherwise user decision. Motor and sensor (b) are reported; a stratum with point < 0.65 is flagged as not supported in B1. This is a recommendation to the user, not an automatic launch.

B0_3_label_and_exposure_audit: per family: dev cases, windows by phase and qualified_y, cases with zero pre_fault windows
per fault case: fault_onset_row x 0.02 s (pre-fault length), distribution per family and flight directory
post_fault_normal and transition windows: counts and which cases
valid exposure hours (row_input_valid & row_label_valid, x 0.02 s / 3600) for dev normal_full flights and for pre-fault segments of dev fault cases
per dev_fold: cases and windows by family

not_allowed: opening any sealed-partition case or window file, or computing anything on sealed ledger rows
the old internal test; source val/test changes
hyperparameter or weight search; feature changes; relabelling or excluding cases after seeing results
event replay, operating-point choice, M0/MSTCA inference, GPU, T1 training
outputs: artifacts/real_v2_b0_diagnostics/ (results.json, oof_predictions.csv, label_audit.csv, reproduction_gate.json, run.log, execution_notes.md); script scripts/research/real_v2_b0_diagnostics.py; report docs/research/2026-11-08/跨域B0诊断结果_v1.md
